course_name: 數位信號處理器應用技術
outline: This course consists of lectures on the theory of digital signal processing (DSP) and labs on Texas Instruments® C28xx DSPs. In the beginning of this course, digital-time signals, systems, and transforms are reviewed. Also, digital filter design including FIR and IIR filters are presented. Then, application implementation on speech, audio, and image processing is introduced. Last, labs on some DSP algorithms are performed on C28xx DSPs.
